clips.title: The story
paras: At Aldrassil, Tenaron Stormgrip asks young night elves to draw sacred water before they leave Shadowglen. The rite recalls Mount Hyjal and the immortality their people gave up there.

Before young night elves leave Shadowglen, their elders teach them what their people lost. At the Battle of Mount Hyjal, the kaldorei sacrificed the World Tree Nordrassil to defeat Archimonde and banish the Burning Legion. The blast cost them their ageless immortality and sacred shield. Tenaron Stormgrip teaches this history as he gives novices a rite, preparing them with humility and purpose for a changing world.

To complete the rite, you draw water from the moonwell north of Aldrassil with a crystal phial. Moonwell waters carry remnants of the ancient Well of Eternity. Druids channel their restorative power into the wild, while Sentinels honor the wells as tranquil shrines to Elune. The kaldorei remain wary: arcane sorcery is forbidden, and the wellspring that sustains their land recalls the reckless magic that nearly broke the world.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: It is time for you to set out to seek your destiny, friend. But before you are ready to set out into the world beyond our enchanted forests, there is much you must learn about our recent history.
Much has changed with our people since the Battle of Mount Hyjal. Nordrassil lies a pale shadow of what it once was, its power used to defeat Archimonde and drive back the Burning Legion...
There is a task you must perform. Go to the moonwell north of Aldrassil and return me a phial of its water.

clips.title: Progress
paras: The moonwells hold the waters of the Well of Eternity, the ancient source of magic that has wrought so many horrors upon our world.
The druids take advantage of its properties, and the Sentinels revere the wells as shrines to Elune, but sorcery is forbidden to all.

clips.title: Completion
paras: So you have heard the first part of the aftermath of the Battle of Mount Hyjal. There is much more to be told and the task you have begun here will continue through the rest of your journey through Teldrassil and into Darnassus.
